info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Agreement Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Agreement Retrieval API provides access to customer agreements stored within the banking management system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information based on a specific agreement identifier. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and banking personnel who need to access agreement details for customer inquiries or compliance checks. By facilitating quick access to agreement specifics, this API enhances customer support and operational efficiency.

get.description: Fetches the details of a specific customer agreement identified by the provided ID. This endpoint returns comprehensive information about the agreement and its associated terms.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the customer agreement details for a specific customer identified by the provided Customer ID (CUST-100045). It includes necessary parameters to filter and customize the response based on the client's requirement.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning customer agreement details.

GetCustomerAgreementByIdRequest.description: Represents the request body for the GET operation on the customer agreement with ID CUST-100045.

GetCustomerAgreementByIdResponse_200.title: Customer Agreement Response

partyId.description: Unique identifier for the party involved in the agreement.

productCode.description: Code representing the product associated with the agreement.

effectiveDate.description: Date when the agreement becomes effective.

relationshipTier.description: Tier level of the relationship for the customer.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the agreement record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the agreement record.

GetCustomerAgreementByIdResponse_200.description: Schema representing the response of a customer agreement details request.

processingRegion.description: Region where the processing took place.

Metadata.description: Schema representing the metadata of the API response.

bearerAuth.description: Authentication using a Bearer token. This method requires clients to include a JSON Web Token (JWT) in the Authorization header of their requests. The server will validate the token to authorize access to protected resources.
